caption: The drawing depicts a single cushioned stool with a dark, almost black, rectangular seat that has slightly rounded edges and corners. The cushion rests on a wooden frame that is reddish-brown in color. The frame consists of a rectangular border directly under the seat and four curved legs that cross at the center beneath the stool. At the crossing point of the legs, there is a decorative cylindrical wooden element with carved details. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or decorative elements, and there is a handwritten signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Stool
